author: Zintenka
body:
"I introduce to you! The successor to Cheaghalov Station! Caernarvon Station! With this comes greater space - yet more compactness to allow gladiators to hone their skills! Capture and hold down the middle and destroy the enemy's monument to win!"

"With this map, you will be able to experience great joy and freedom as you employ all your tactics to win and maybe learn some new ones! Raid and hunker down in the diamond spawners in each corner of the map! Set up a long ranged diagonal cannon and bombard the enemy monument from home base!"

"Your emperor commands this!" - Emperor Hich Vaeksaenct, 14897 - 25 years after Cheaghalov Station destruction by Charghan Forces

Author:
- War Marshall Zintenka Brimem of the Charghan Egalitarium - Commander of all military branches in the third quadrant

"Emperor Hich Vaeksaenct is a bloody murderer who sold out his own people for personal gain. He's a whore - a sellout to the highest bidder and a crazed criminal. The end of this monster is near and his indoctrinated people will be freed from his cold. Dead. Corpse." - Zintenka, 14901 - Comment to subordinates and media after knowledge of Hich's new station becoming widespread.



Features:
  • 1 one monument for each team at opposite corners of the map (Destroy 75% of it to win)
  • 1 central capture point (5000 points in total. Every second gives 50 points)
  • Iron spawner in the lower center of each base
  • Diamond spawners at both corners of the map
  • Pathways that are only open to a specific team
  • Haste 3 for burrowing into the monument

XML
Images 
Download 

Charghan military structure:
War Marshalls - Individuals who've lived through millenia of warfare due to Charghans' limitless longevity. They are handpicked by a council of Marshalls. Commanders of all operations within. (These guys can kill you just by looking at you)
Marshalls - The second highest ranking officials who've lived just as long as War Marshalls. Possibly even longer depending on the individual. Supreme leaders within their own specific branches of military. (Voted on by a council of Marshalls based upon merit)
Kaivhas - Individuals who are commanders of fleets, ground forces or espionage ops. Similar to Lieutenants or Majors. (Takes 25 - 500 years to be promoted)
Falorjas - Leaders of battalions or platoons (Takes 10 years to go up)
Ghrenfios - Squad leaders (Usually takes  3 or 4 to command battalions and platoons)
Soldiers - Kek (Usually takes 1 or 2 years to be promoted)
